description:
Exactly what the caller's key holds. No arguments: every lane per layer with its series
count. layer=raw|derived|node and lane=1min|hour|daily|...: every series name there. Call
this before tilla_latest / tilla_window and use the names it returns. Needs your API key (hosted: the X-API-Key header; local: TILLA_API_KEY).
name: tilla_inventory
title: Series this key holds
